title: delphinium pentagynum f. gautieri
intro: Delphinium pentagynum f. gautieri, commonly known as the Alpine Delphinium or Delphinium gautieri, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium pentagynum f. gautieri include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which may contribute to its use in treating nervous system disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
